Cystine Stones.  ​Cystine stones represent 1% to 2% of uri-
nary calculi and are caused by homozygous cystinuria. Cystine 
stones affect approximately 1 in 15,000 persons in the United 
States. Whereas normal individuals daily excrete 20 mg or less 
of cystine in their urine, stone-forming cystinuric patients ex-
crete more than 250 mg/day. Cystine solubility increases when
